cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit with me before you ring anyone. There's a change to the wedding venue, but we're keeping the date in front of us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What changed? Have they cancelled our booking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The date is still ours. The building can't be used, so we'll choose somewhere else for that day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There was a fire. Nobody was hurt. Give yourself a minute; then bring me the guest list, and we'll choose a room big enough for the same people.

reason: Make A control protective disclosure and next manageable choice: booking question reveals building loss, cause question reveals fire, and A retains date/people as concrete planning anchors.
